AC4 FAIL: HeaderRow::isSelectable() and MergedRow::isSelectable() incorrectly return true when the grid has actions. The base class BaseGridRow::isSelectable() delegates to $this->manager->getGrid()->hasActions(). Neither HeaderRow nor MergedRow overrides isSelectable() to return false. Fix required: add `public function isSelectable(): bool { return false; }` override to both HeaderRow and MergedRow.

comments.note: AC4 VIOLATION — BaseGridRow::isSelectable() returns $this->manager->getGrid()->hasActions(), so when a grid has actions configured, HeaderRow::isSelectable() and MergedRow::isSelectable() both return true instead of the required false. Root cause: HeaderRow and MergedRow do not override isSelectable(). Fix: add `public function isSelectable(): bool { return false; }` to both src/Grids/Rows/Types/HeaderRow.php and src/Grids/Rows/Types/MergedRow.php.

summary: Code review PASS. All four acceptance criteria verified independently (47/47 tests, 7 pre-existing PHPStan errors only, getGrid() and isSelectable() correctly implemented in BaseGridRow, explicit false overrides in HeaderRow and MergedRow). Implementation is clean, idiomatic PHP 8.4, follows all project conventions. Two non-blocking items noted (pre-existing duplicate manager property in StandardRow; redundant same-namespace import in RowManager), neither warrant blocking.

comments.note: BaseGridRow.php: isSelectable() null guard (returns false when manager is null) is correctly defensive. HeaderRow and MergedRow override this and return false unconditionally — doubly safe, no path exists that returns true for these structural row types.

StandardRow still carries a private RowManager $manager shadowing BaseGridRow::$manager (both private). Functionally both are set to the same instance (constructor + registerRow hits both), but the duplication is a maintenance hazard — future readers must understand private property shadowing to confirm they're identical. Recommend removing StandardRow::$manager in a follow-up WP and routing internal calls through a protected getManager() method on BaseGridRow.

RowManager.php: `use AppUtils\Grids\Rows\BaseGridRow;` is a redundant import — both RowManager and BaseGridRow share the AppUtils\Grids\Rows namespace. Classes in the same namespace are auto-visible without importing. Harmless but adds noise; remove in a cleanup pass.

phpunit.xml.dist creation was the correct fix. The missing config file was silently causing PHPUnit to print its usage banner instead of running tests, making the test suite unrunnable via composer scripts. This is a genuine improvement to the dev toolchain.
